rules.labelled: 2026-10-16, from titles only, before any formula change. Candidates: each replay day's top 40 under the 2026-10-16 production formula at 12:00 UTC, every story with importance >= 8, and every headline the drama regex matched (so its precision is measurable). 14 days of production rows.

rise.release: a new model, model version or open-weights release from a lab of any size, including a first availability on a major platform when it is the lab's launch; not fine-tune variants, listings, podcasts or roundups
rise.benchmark: a frontier benchmark result or a model taking a leaderboard spot
rise.tech: a major tech launch: chips, devtools, agent products, infra platforms, robots, big launch events (DevDay)
rise.research: a lab result that moves the frontier (proofs, new algorithms, clinic-grade findings); a generic paper is neutral/research
rise.drama: lawsuits, subpoenas, regulators probing a lab, firings/resignations/ousters, leaks, public feuds and accusations, security incidents caused by or hitting AI agents and labs, boycotts/backlash, safety rollbacks
rise.breaking: government action taken (law, order, arrest, appointment, export control, moratorium, accord signed), strikes on infrastructure, outages of major AI services

fall.markets: stock moves, indexes, market caps, revenue/earnings figures, bond and debt pricing, valuations in the market sense
fall.macro: macro forecasts and warnings (IMF, Fed, World Bank, growth and bubble calls)
fall.hr: HR memos, layoffs framed as jobs commentary, staff cuts, workforce pieces
fall.analyst: consultancy reports, analyst predictions, surveys, think pieces about adoption
fall.trend: generic 'companies pull back / rush in' trend pieces

neutral.research: a paper or study without a frontier claim
neutral.product: a consumer or business feature, plan or device update
neutral.policy: proposals, hearings, letters, statements, bills not yet law, court decisions about non-lab parties
neutral.funding: funding rounds, IPO plans, grants, pledges, loans to a lab (not market moves)

rules.note: Labels were frozen before tuning. Disagreements noticed later are listed in the PR body, not edited here.
